name: Move with Ava
tagline: Yoga and mat Pilates at your office, and sunrise pop-ups on the roof.
bio: I'm Ava. Four mornings a week I teach high-intensity Pilates at a boutique studio in Manhattan; the rest of the time I bring classes to teams. Desk-to-mat yoga at lunch, a mat Pilates burn that needs no machines, and pop-up classes on a rooftop when the weather's good. All levels, every body, no one gets left in a pose they hate.

shop.title: Open rooftop classes
shop.note: Public pop-ups when the forecast is kind. Bring water; mats provided.
shop.where: A rooftop in Flatiron (address sent after you book)

items.name: Five-class pass
items.desc: Use it at any pop-up this season.

terms: Free to cancel up to 72 hours before. Rain on a rooftop class: we move indoors or reschedule, your call.
backupPlan: Two instructors I teach alongside cover for me; you get their names when you book.

experiences.name: Desk-to-mat yoga at your office
experiences.desc: A 45-minute flow in a conference room: shoulders, hips, breath. Office clothes are fine; no one gets on the floor who doesn't want to.
includes: A 5-minute desk routine card to keep
experiences.allIn: Mats, travel in Manhattan and Brooklyn, and tax.
experiences.access: Chair version for anyone who prefers it; fully seated option on request.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people follow along on video; I cue for both rooms.
experiences.setup: A cleared room about 6 × 8 ft per person, or a lobby after hours.
experiences.branding: Mats or water bottles with your logo, if you'd like to keep them. Needs 2 weeks.
runOfShow: 0:00 Mats down, quick check-in on injuries
0:30 Hips and back on the mat (or a chair)

experiences.name: Mat Pilates burn
experiences.desc: Studio-style Pilates without the machines: slow, deep core work that shakes in the best way. Modifications for every level.
experiences.access: Modifications for pregnancy, wrists and lower back.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people need only a mat or a towel.
experiences.setup: A cleared room or a quiet floor.

experiences.name: Rooftop sunrise pop-up
experiences.desc: Yoga on your rooftop or a terrace we arrange, with coffee after. A morning people talk about at lunch.
experiences.allIn: Mats, coffee, a second instructor above 40 people, and tax. Rooftop rental quoted separately if you don't have one.
experiences.access: Needs an elevator to the roof; chair options available.
experiences.dietary: Coffee with oat milk, fruit; tell me about allergies.
experiences.setup: A flat roof or terrace and permission from the building. Sound is a small speaker, nothing loud.
experiences.branding: A banner, mats or a coffee-cup sleeve with your logo. Needs 2 weeks.

experiences.name: Wellness week: four classes
experiences.desc: One class a day for a week: yoga, Pilates, a breathwork session and a rooftop finale. Mix in-office and remote.
includes: A short recap with attendance for your team
experiences.access: Every class has a seated option.
experiences.dietary: Coffee and fruit at the finale.
experiences.hybrid: Every class streams for remote people.
experiences.setup: A room for three days, a roof or terrace for the finale.
